name: MieTrak Tools
description: A library of small MieTrak helpers behind a picker. Hardware Code Generator plus the Code Reference chart.
author: Anthony Sieben

how_it_works: Pick a tool from the left list; its form shows on the right.

Hardware Code Generator: choose the system (imperial or metric), the material and coating, and the hardware type. The rows you still need appear: thread size for screws, studs and nuts; length for screws and studs; screw size for washers.

The part number builds itself as you pick, and under it the code is read back to you piece by piece so you learn what each part means. Press Copy Code to put it on the clipboard, then paste it into MieTrak.

Code Reference: the chart behind the generator. It shows how a code is built, which rows each hardware type needs, and how to read the thread and length codes. Paste a code you already have into the decode box and it is spelled out in plain English. Below that is every option list, with a filter box and an imperial/metric switch.
output: The MieTrak hardware code on screen and on the clipboard - nothing is saved to a file.
